import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI / Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level colored by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_plot = df.copy()
df_plot['Sleep Disorder'] = df_plot['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.scatterplot(data=df_plot, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level',
                hue='Sleep Disorder', palette='Set2', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Duration and Quality by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=True)

x = range(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.barh([i - width/2 for i in x], occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], 
                  width, label='Sleep Duration (hrs)', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax3.barh([i + width/2 for i in x], occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep'], 
                  width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='coral', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_yticks(x)
ax3.set_yticklabels(occupation_stats.index, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Value', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Age Group and Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[20, 30, 40, 50, 60], 
                          labels=['20-30', '30-40', '40-50', '50-60'])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Age Group', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', 
            palette='Set1', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Age Group and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
